dialogues.jp: そう、だよな。
dialogues.en: That's right.
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.jp:
病み上がりの音夢に無理をさせることは出来な
い。
dialogues.en: I shouldn't take advantage of Nemu being sick.
dialogues.text: I shouldn't take advantage of Nemu being sick.

dialogues.jp:
｛こんしん／渾身｝の力をこめて、ゆっくりと音夢の身体を離
してソファーに座らせた。
dialogues.en: I let Nemu go slowly and let her sit on the sofa.
dialogues.text: I let Nemu go slowly and let her sit on the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あるんだよ。だって、抱きしめるだけだって、
　こんなに心臓がドキドキしてるんだぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I guess we can do this any time from now on."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I guess we can do this any time from now on."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: I shrugged, sitting next to Nemu, and tried not to cry.
dialogues.text: I shrugged, sitting next to Nemu, and tried not to cry.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「キスなんかしたら、心臓が保たないよ」
dialogues.en: "Wh-Wh-What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-Wh-What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺だって嫌いじゃない……」
dialogues.en: "I mean when you get better."
dialogues.text: "I mean when you get better."

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、と音夢を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I held her tightly.
dialogues.text: I held her tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Oh...... Okay. Thank you, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... Okay. Thank you, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
背中に伸びてきた音夢の手が、ぎゅっと抱き返
してくる。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: たどたどしいその感触が愛おしくて。
dialogues.en: Nemu's smiling.
dialogues.text: Nemu's smiling.

dialogues.jp:
すぐ目の前にある音夢の髪から匂う香りが甘く
て。
dialogues.en:
She's leaning her head against my chest and smiling like
she's really happy.
dialogues.text:
She's leaning her head against my chest and smiling like
she's really happy.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ……」
dialogues.en: "Can I call you oniichan when we're alone?"
dialogues.text: "Can I call you oniichan when we're alone?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢がクスクスと微笑んでいる。
「なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: She's making me so happy I might cry......
dialogues.text: She's making me so happy I might cry......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとにドキドキしてるなぁ……って……」
dialogues.en: "It makes me feel close to you when I call you that......"
dialogues.text: "It makes me feel close to you when I call you that......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の胸に手を耳を当てて、本当に幸せそうに微
笑んでいた。
dialogues.en: "Call me that again."
dialogues.text: "Call me that again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これって、私を抱きしめてくれてるから……
　なんだよね？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だとしたら、すごく嬉しいな……って……」
dialogues.en: Nemu tilted her head a little.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilted her head a little.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "......Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "......Oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: ……クソ。可愛いじゃねえか。

俺は音夢の顔を胸に押しつけるように、きつく
抱きしめた。
dialogues.en: I really liked the sound of it.
dialogues.text: I really liked the sound of it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっ……兄さん！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan, can I have a Japanese sweet?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan, can I have a Japanese sweet?"

dialogues.jp:
我ながら大人げないと思いつつも……何だか嬉
しくって、照れくさくって。
dialogues.en: "What? What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What? What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: こうでもしなけりゃ、やってられなかったのだ。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled a little.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled a little.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もうっ、兄さんったら……」
dialogues.en:
"You can make them come out of your hands, right? I know
everything about you......"
dialogues.text:
"You can make them come out of your hands, right? I know
everything about you......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、嬉しいよ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, yeah...... but I thought you didn't like them."
dialogues.text: "Well, yeah...... but I thought you didn't like them."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Well, I like them. But I was being stubborn about it."
dialogues.text: "Well, I like them. But I was being stubborn about it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 胸元で音夢が小さく笑みを漏らす。
dialogues.en:
How does not liking the Japanese sweets and being stubborn
relate to each other?
dialogues.text:
How does not liking the Japanese sweets and being stubborn
relate to each other?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「手から出せるんでしょ？　知ってるよ……兄
　さんのことはなんでも……」
dialogues.en:
"Remember Sakura used to ask you for them, niisan, and you
used to make Sakura Japanese sweets? I..."
dialogues.text:
"Remember Sakura used to ask you for them, niisan, and you
used to make Sakura Japanese sweets? I..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、まぁ、それもなんだが……和菓子はお
　前」
dialogues.en: "I really envied Sakura."
dialogues.text: "I really envied Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん……本当は好きなの。でもずっと……そ
　の、意地張ってて」
dialogues.en: "That's all?"
dialogues.text: "That's all?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「意地？」
和菓子が嫌いなのと意地がどう関わるんだ？
dialogues.en: "Haha... What a stubborn girl."
dialogues.text: "Haha... What a stubborn girl."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、兄さんさくらにねだられて良くお菓子
　をあげてたでしょ……あれ見て、私……」
dialogues.en:
I closed my hand lightly, and I brought it close to her
mouth.
dialogues.text:
I closed my hand lightly, and I brought it close to her
mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私ね……さくらが｛うらや／羨｝ましかったんだよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「な、ってそれだけで！？」
dialogues.en: Nemu ate the small bun and my fingers as well.
dialogues.text: Nemu ate the small bun and my fingers as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だってぇ」
dialogues.en: "Not my fingers!"
dialogues.text: "Not my fingers!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ははっ。仕方ない奴だな」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't help it...... It's really good."
dialogues.text: "I couldn't help it...... It's really good."

dialogues.jp: 軽く手を閉じて、そのまま音夢の口元に寄せる。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled happily and covered her cheeks with her hands.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled happily and covered her cheeks with her hands.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en:
"It's really been a long time. This's the first one I've had
since grandma gave them to us when we were kids."
dialogues.text:
"It's really been a long time. This's the first one I've had
since grandma gave them to us when we were kids."

dialogues.jp: 頬をおさえて、音夢が本当に嬉しそうに微笑む。
dialogues.en: "I didn't know you liked them. That's such a stupid reason."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know you liked them. That's such a stupid reason."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「久しぶりだなぁ……子供の頃、おばあちゃん
　にもらって以来だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not stupid. I really envied Sakura."
dialogues.text: "It's not stupid. I really envied Sakura."

dialogues.jp: ｛あくび／欠伸｝｛ま／雑｝じりに音夢が首を傾ける。
dialogues.en: Nemu tilted her head as she yawned.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilted her head as she yawned.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: とん、と音夢が俺によりかかった。
dialogues.en: Nemu leaned against me.
dialogues.text: Nemu leaned against me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっ、と俺の服をつかんで音夢が寝息をたて
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu held onto my pajamas and she fell asleep.
dialogues.text: Nemu held onto my pajamas and she fell asleep.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いっか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh well......"
dialogues.text: "Oh well......"

dialogues.jp:
どうしてか――春だからか、どんなに寝ても、
すぐに眠くなる。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why, but I get sleepy no matter how much I
sleep.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why, but I get sleepy no matter how much I
sleep.

dialogues.jp: 春眠暁を覚えずというが……。
dialogues.en: Is it because of the spring?
dialogues.text: Is it because of the spring?

dialogues.jp:
なにも言わず音夢を抱きよせて、俺も心地よい
まどろみに身を任せた。
dialogues.en: I held Nemu closer to me and I fell asleep as well.
dialogues.text: I held Nemu closer to me and I fell asleep as well.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢のためにしないこと◆
dialogues.en: ◆What I don't do for Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆What I don't do for Nemu◆

dialogues.jp: 音夢の体調を考えて今日はキスを見送る。
dialogues.en:
I thought Nemu was still sick, so I didn't go any further
today.
dialogues.text:
I thought Nemu was still sick, so I didn't go any further
today.

dialogues.jp:
男としてはちょっと悲しかったが、ふたりでソ
ファーに座りながら、お互いの暖かさをずっと
感じられたから充分だった。
dialogues.en:
It was a little disappointing, but we sat on the sofa
feeling each other's warmth.
dialogues.text:
It was a little disappointing, but we sat on the sofa
feeling each other's warmth.
